summary: On 23 May 2026 EnviroLink reported that the new Welsh environment minister had declared that the ban on spreading muck and agricultural waste in the closed period "doesn't work". The report described this as a significant shift that could lead the government to revise or abandon the current approach to agricultural water protection under the Control of Agricultural Pollution Regulations. Farming unions had campaigned against the calendar-based closed periods ahead of the May 2026 Senedd election.
title: New Welsh environment minister declares the closed-period ban on spreading slurry and manure ineffective, signalling a revision of the agricultural pollution rules
